caption: The drawing depicts a single transparent red glass mug with a handle on the right side, centrally positioned on a plain, light beige background. The mug is cylindrical and slightly tapers toward the base. The glass has a glossy appearance with multiple light reflections, which create areas of lighter pink and white on its surface. There is a decorative graphic element on the left side of the mug that includes white lines and what appears to be circular and organic shapes, along with some stylized lettering. No other objects or elements are present in the drawing, and the background is empty aside from the mug. The artist's name, "FRANK KEANE," is faintly written in the lower-left corner.
title: American "Bohemian" Glass Mug
